about: Claim heads recognised by scripts/claims.py (docs/claim-strength.md). A conclusion head counts only when the audited declaration has exactly this defining module and kernel fingerprint (tools/Assurance.lean: type and value). tools/Assurance.lean imports every module listed under `heads`, so a same-named declaration elsewhere is a name clash. program/state are argument positions (implicit arguments included) of the computation the claim is about and of its initial state. `bound` names the unit of an explicit return bound the head states (loop_body_runs, scheduler_turns) and `bound_arg` its argument position, whose value or printed form a manifest goal's `bound` ({unit, max} or {unit, expr}) is checked against. A new head is added here with its fingerprint from `scripts/claims.py heads`. `reserved` lists the retired legacy claim heads (name: the module that defined it). They are not imported. A theorem whose conclusion head has a reserved name supports no claim, whatever its module or fingerprint, and a hypothesis that mentions one is rejected like one that mentions a registered head. A reserved name is never registered again.
